SECTION 1: SPEC BULLET ANALYSIS

✅ * Select electrons with pT > 25 GeV and |eta| < 2.5; computed as: [e for e in get_electrons(event) if e['pt'] > 25 and abs(e['eta']) < 2.5]; upstream chain: get_electrons(event) -> event['objects'] with type == 1; 〔L0298-L0299〕
✅ * Select muons with pT > 25 GeV and |eta| < 2.4; computed as: [m for m in get_muons(event) if m['pt'] > 25 and abs(m['eta']) < 2.4]; upstream chain: get_muons(event) -> event['objects'] with type == 2; 〔L0299-L0300〕
✅ * Require exactly one lepton (electron or muon); computed as: if len(leptons) != 1: continue; upstream chain: leptons = electrons + muons; 〔L0302-L0304〕
✅ * Require at least 4 jets with pT > 30 GeV and |eta| < 2.5; computed as: [j for j in get_jets(event) if j['pt'] > 30 and abs(j['eta']) < 2.5]; upstream chain: get_jets(event) -> event['objects'] with type == 4; 〔L0309-L0311〕
✅ * Among these selected jets, require at least 2 b-tagged jets; computed as: [b for b in get_bjets(event) if b['pt'] > 30 and abs(b['eta']) < 2.5]; upstream chain: get_bjets(event) -> event['objects'] with type == 4 and btag == 1; 〔L0315-L0317〕
✅ * Among the selected b-tagged jets, define the b-jet closest to the selected lepton in delta R; computed as: min(bjets, key=lambda b: helper_delta_r(b, lepton)); upstream chain: helper_delta_r(b, lepton) -> helper_delta_phi(phi1, phi2) -> math.sqrt(deta^2 + dphi^2); 〔L0321-L0322〕
✅ * Select MET > 20 GeV; computed as: if met is None or met['pt'] < 20: continue; upstream chain: helper_get_met(event) -> event['objects'] with type == 6; 〔L0326-L0328〕
✅ * Select transverse mass of the lepton and MET between 30 and 150 GeV (W candidate); computed as: if not (30 < mt < 150): continue; upstream chain: helper_transverse_mass(lepton, met) -> math.sqrt(2 * visible['pt'] * met['pt'] * (1 - math.cos(dphi))); 〔L0333-L0335〕
✅ * Build the hadronic W candidate from the two leading selected non-b-tagged jets; computed as: sum_objects(light_jets_sorted[0], light_jets_sorted[1]); upstream chain: light_jets_sorted = sorted(light_jets, key=lambda j: j['pt'], reverse=True); light_jets = [j for j in jets if j not in bjets]; 〔L0343-L0345〕
✅ * Select the hadronic W mass between 40 to 120 GeV; computed as: if w_hadronic is None or not (40 < w_hadronic['mass'] < 120): continue; upstream chain: helper_invariant_mass(light_jets_sorted[0], light_jets_sorted[1]) -> sum_objects -> obj_from_four_momentum -> math.sqrt(E^2 - p^2); 〔L0346-L0347〕
✅ * Build the hadronic top candidate from the leading selected b-tagged jet and the hadronic W candidate; computed as: sum_objects(bjets_sorted[0], w_hadronic); upstream chain: bjets_sorted = sorted(bjets, key=lambda j: j['pt'], reverse=True); 〔L0352-L0354〕
✅ * Select the hadronic top mass between 100 to 250 GeV; computed as: if top_hadronic is None or not (100 < top_hadronic['mass'] < 250): continue; upstream chain: helper_invariant_mass(bjets_sorted[0], w_hadronic) -> sum_objects -> obj_from_four_momentum -> math.sqrt(E^2 - p^2); 〔L0355-L0356〕

✅ * Plot the transverse mass of lepton + MET (W leptonic candidate); computed as: mt_values; upstream chain: helper_transverse_mass(lepton, met) -> math.sqrt(2 * visible['pt'] * met['pt'] * (1 - math.cos(dphi))); 〔L0332-L0336〕
✅ * Plot the MET distribution; computed as: met_values; upstream chain: helper_get_met(event) -> event['objects'] with type == 6; 〔L0329-L0330〕
✅ * Plot the pT of the leading b-jet; computed as: bjet1_pt; upstream chain: bjets_sorted[0]['pt']; 〔L0359〕
✅ * Plot the pT of the subleading b-jet; computed as: bjet2_pt; upstream chain: bjets_sorted[1]['pt']; 〔L0360〕
✅ * Plot the invariant mass of the W hadronic candidate in range 40 to 120 GeV; computed as: w_hadronic_mass; upstream chain: helper_invariant_mass(light_jets_sorted[0], light_jets_sorted[1]) -> sum_objects -> obj_from_four_momentum -> math.sqrt(E^2 - p^2); 〔L0348-L0349〕
✅ * Plot the invariant mass of the hadronic top candidate in range 100 to 250 GeV; computed as: top_hadronic_mass; upstream chain: helper_invariant_mass(bjets_sorted[0], w_hadronic) -> sum_objects -> obj_from_four_momentum -> math.sqrt(E^2 - p^2); 〔L0356-L0357〕
✅ * Plot delta R between the leading lepton and the closest selected b-jet; computed as: dr_lepton_bjet; upstream chain: helper_delta_r(b, lepton) -> helper_delta_phi(phi1, phi2) -> math.sqrt(deta^2 + dphi^2); 〔L0322-L0323〕
✅ * Plot the HT distribution (scalar sum of all jet pT); computed as: ht_values; upstream chain: scalar_pt_sum(jets) -> sum(p['pt'] for p in particles); 〔L0363〕
✅ * Plot the number of jets per event; computed as: njets_values; upstream chain: len(jets); 〔L0364〕
✅ * Plot eta of the leading b-jet; computed as: bjet1_eta; upstream chain: bjets_sorted[0]['eta']; 〔L0361〕

SECTION 2: DEFINITION SUMMARY

* [CHECK CAREFULLY] DEFINITION SUMMARY

* Selected electrons
  - computed/defined as: [e for e in get_electrons(event) if e['pt'] > 25 and abs(e['eta']) < 2.5]
  - upstream chain: get_electrons(event) -> [o for o in event['objects'] if o['type'] == 1]
  - collection definition: event['objects'] with type == 1
  - structure: single-constituent

* Selected muons
  - computed/defined as: [m for m in get_muons(event) if m['pt'] > 25 and abs(m['eta']) < 2.4]
  - upstream chain: get_muons(event) -> [o for o in event['objects'] if o['type'] == 2]
  - collection definition: event['objects'] with type == 2
  - structure: single-constituent

* Leptons
  - computed/defined as: electrons + muons
  - upstream chain: electrons = [e for e in get_electrons(event) if e['pt'] > 25 and abs(e['eta']) < 2.5]; muons = [m for m in get_muons(event) if m['pt'] > 25 and abs(m['eta']) < 2.4]
  - collection definition: electrons + muons
  - structure: multi-input

* Selected jets
  - computed/defined as: [j for j in get_jets(event) if j['pt'] > 30 and abs(j['eta']) < 2.5]
  - upstream chain: get_jets(event) -> [o for o in event['objects'] if o['type'] == 4]
  - collection definition: event['objects'] with type == 4
  - structure: single-constituent

* Selected b-jets
  - computed/defined as: [b for b in get_bjets(event) if b['pt'] > 30 and abs(b['eta']) < 2.5]
  - upstream chain: get_bjets(event) -> [o for o in event['objects'] if o['type'] == 4 and int(o['btag']) == 1]
  - collection definition: event['objects'] with type == 4 and btag == 1
  - structure: single-constituent

* MET
  - computed/defined as: helper_get_met(event)
  - upstream chain: helper_get_met(event) -> [o for o in event['objects'] if o['type'] == 6]
  - collection definition: event['objects'] with type == 6
  - structure: single-constituent

* Transverse mass of lepton + MET
  - computed/defined as: helper_transverse_mass(lepton, met)
  - upstream chain: helper_transverse_mass(lepton, met) -> math.sqrt(2 * visible['pt'] * met['pt'] * (1 - math.cos(dphi)))
  - collection definition: lepton from selected leptons, met from helper_get_met(event)
  - structure: composite-derived

* Hadronic W candidate
  - computed/defined as: sum_objects(light_jets_sorted[0], light_jets_sorted[1])
  - upstream chain: light_jets_sorted = sorted(light_jets, key=lambda j: j['pt'], reverse=True); light_jets = [j for j in jets if j not in bjets]
  - collection definition: jets with type == 4 and not in bjets
  - structure: composite-derived

* Hadronic W mass
  - computed/defined as: helper_invariant_mass(light_jets_sorted[0], light_jets_sorted[1])
  - upstream chain: helper_invariant_mass(light_jets_sorted[0], light_jets_sorted[1]) -> sum_objects -> obj_from_four_momentum -> math.sqrt(E^2 - p^2)
